items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: "I know who he is," the guy kept saying. "I know him!" ... "They call him Dipper. His name is Louis Armstrong."

ctx.x: like that." So finally, as they're marching, Louis had that horn up there with that little old red hat on, just blowing up a breeze. He's got his little head up there, overpowering everybody. So when they got by, naturally we were going to light out. But before, some guy in the back of me or something, he's a railroad porter on a train, he says, "I know who that is. They call him Dipper. His name is Louis Armstrong." "I know who he is," the guy kept saying. "I know him!" In the meantime, we're gone, making that…
Did they do second line in Baton Rouge like they do in New Orleans?
